events/2026-12-01-online-event-driven-bu.title: Event-Driven Business Processes: Collaboration and Context in the Autonomous Enterprise (EMEA & MEE)
events/2026-12-01-online-event-driven-bu.description: Build the event-driven foundation for better agentic AI. Connected agents that collaborate are the beginning of better business execution. But as organizations move toward Autonomous Enterprise, IT leaders need a way to ensure AI agents react to business events and reason with current context. Acting across complex applications, data, and process landscapes in real time becomes the big challenge. Join this webinar to explore why event-driven architecture is becoming the operational foundation for trusted, scalable agentic AI. Discover how SAP Integration Suite, advanced event mesh, and SAP HANA Cloud, as part of SAP Business AI Platform, can help unify AI agents, applications, systems, and data with governed connectivity, real-time awareness, and trusted business context. You’ll learn about: Using business context to improve agent decisions and manage operational overhead Supporting scalable AI adoption with a flexible event-driven architecture Enabling governed pathways for AI agents to take trusted action Get ready to go from standalone agents to integrated agentic operations with the beginning of real-time AI execution.

events/2026-12-02-online-can-finance-tru.title: Can Finance Trust AI? (Americas)
events/2026-12-02-online-can-finance-tru.description: AI is reshaping finance, but most organizations are still running pilots rather than scaling them. For many CFOs, three questions decide what happens next: Can we trust the data? Can we control the process? Can we demonstrate the return? SAP experts answer all three. You will see why AI embedded in SAP Cloud ERP—acting on the same transactional data layer that drives your finance operations—differs architecturally from disconnected point solutions, and what that means for governance, latency, and reconciliation risk. A product demonstration shows selected finance workflows in practice. Where initiatives stall: Fragmented data, manual close processes, and audit risk keep AI in finance at pilot stage. Embedded AI on Cloud ERP addresses these at the data layer. How to evaluate: A CFO-ready framework for assessing SAP Autonomous Finance and Joule against CFO-relevant workflows and ROI dimensions—efficiency, accuracy, and strategic capacity.

events/2026-12-02-online-transforming-re.title: High-Volume Hiring: Transforming Recruitment with SmartRecruiters for SAP SuccessFactors (Americas)
events/2026-12-02-online-transforming-re.description: High-volume hiring can put pressure on legacy recruiting processes as application volumes rise. In this session, you’ll see how SmartRecruiters for SAP SuccessFactors can help modernize recruiting with AI-enabled tools and automation. Follow a live walk-through of the platform and explore use cases that show how organizations are approaching hiring at scale with SmartRecruiters. You’ll also hear from experts who have guided customers through this transition firsthand and learn what to consider when moving from SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting. Topics include: Using AI to support high-volume talent pipelines Simplifying the experience for recruiters and hiring managers Creating smoother experiences for candidates Planning your move to SmartRecruiters See the product in action and leave with a clearer understanding of how SmartRecruiters can support your recruiting operations.

events/2026-12-02-online-unlock-ai-innov.title: Unlock AI, Innovation, and Cost Efficiency: Modernizing SAP HANA with SAP Business AI Platform
events/2026-12-02-online-unlock-ai-innov.description: On-premise SAP HANA investments have delivered decades of value. Now within the era of Agents, Gen AI, business data fabric, they’re reaching limitations. This session makes the case for migrating to SAP HANA Cloud, showing how a cloud-native foundation unlocks AI innovations, reduces infrastructure costs, and positions your enterprise for what comes next. Join SAP experts for a practical walkthrough of the migration path, the business value it delivers, and the new capabilities it opens up, starting from where you are today and getting yourself ready for AI use-cases. Key learnings: Understand why on-premise SAP HANA limits your AI ambitions and how moving to SAP HANA Cloud removes those constraints while preserving your existing investments. Explore the migration path from on-premise SAP HANA to SAP HANA Cloud including available tools, accelerators, and services that streamline the journey from planning to go-live. Discover all AI-centric capabilities of SAP HANA Cloud that become available post-migration, including Interoperability with SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP HANA Cloud Knowledge Graph engine, SAP HANA Cloud Vector engine, advanced embedded AI and machine learning and more capabilities that are not possible with your on-premise deployments. Explore and outline typical use-cases for SAP HANA Cloud including various facets for the use of the capabilities and how to get started with SAP HANA Cloud and where to find more information.
